answers.chinese: 比较两刀的加权 Gini 和熵增益；前者越低、后者越高
answers.english: Case 1 has two pure children, a weighted Gini of zero and an information gain of approximately 0.9183 bits.
For Case 2 only the left child is mixed; the right child contains only Non-Setosa. Its weighted Gini and information gain are approximately 0.2921 and 0.3315 bits.
